services.title: Wedding Films
services.description: Timeless, emotion-driven wedding films documented with cinematic elegance, natural lighting, and intimate visual rhythm.
services.full_description: We treat every wedding as a sacred cinematic epic. Our signature documentary-meets-fine-art approach captures the nervous anticipation, the stolen glances, and the euphoric celebrations without staged clichés.

services.title: Commercial Ads

services.title: Music Videos
services.description: Visually arresting music videos with hypnotic pacing, custom lighting design, and bold stylistic direction for visionary artists.
services.full_description: Collaborating directly with musical artists and record labels, we merge sonic frequency with striking visual worlds — experimenting with optical textures, anamorphic flares, and rhythmically synchronized cuts.

services.title: Documentaries
services.description: Deeply researched, character-driven feature and short documentaries exploring human triumph, art, and environmental wonder.
services.full_description: Our documentary division travels to the furthest corners of the globe to capture raw truth. We prioritize empathetic journalistic integrity combined with festival-grade cinematography.

about_content.heading: ATHUL OLLUR — CINEMATOGRAPHER & VISUAL ARTIST.
about_content.intro: Athul Ollur (Athul Kumar) is a multidisciplinary Director of Photography (DOP), Cinematographer, and Fine Arts Graduate (BFA in Painting from Raja Ravi Varma College of Fine Arts, Kerala University). His visual direction is shaped by a deep mastery of light, color harmony, and human emotion.
about_content.story:
Before looking through a camera viewfinder, Athul Ollur studied the masters of light on canvas. Holding a Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA in Painting) from the historic Raja Ravi Varma College of Fine Arts, Mavelikkara (2015), and having worked as a sculptor at RestoreDesign Bangalore, his cinema aesthetic is anchored in classical painting, dimensional lighting, and spatial rhythm.

From 2016 onwards, Athul built a prolific independent career as a freelance videographer, cinematographer, photographer, and visual artist. He served as lead Cinematographer at Greenmedia (2023–2024), orchestrating commercial advertising campaigns and branded films, before becoming Director of Photography (DOP) at Skillmount Education (2024–2026), where he directs high-production-value video series, masterclasses, and visual narratives.

His work spans luxury destination weddings, commercial films, music videos, documentaries, and large-scale fine art sculptures and paintings across Kerala, Bangalore, and across India.
about_content.philosophy: To me, cinematography is painting with dynamic light across time. My fine arts background taught me that light is not merely illumination — it creates volume, texture, tension, and truth. Every camera movement must have rhythm, intent, and emotional honesty.
about_content.approach: Bridging fine art intuition with technical precision: tailored anamorphic and spherical lens choices, chiaroscuro lighting architecture, fine-tuned post-production across Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Edius, and Photoshop, with holistic art direction from concept sketch to final grade.

experience.description: Directing visual architecture, camera department, lighting setups, and cinematic execution for high-end educational video productions, masterclass series, and brand storytelling.
Spearheaded camera operation, visual branding campaigns, commercial advertisements, promotional films, and creative video content from pre-production to final delivery.
Leading camera, lighting, and creative direction across luxury wedding films, commercial adverts, music videos, documentaries, and fine art commissions.
Sculpted life-size figurative installations, environmental art pieces, and architectural reliefs in plaster, clay, and composite materials.
